statement: Trade Capture enables Market Risk Management
source_definition: Covers the per-transaction lifecycle: analyzing prospective deals, obtaining approval within the delegation of authority, capturing executed physical, exchange, storage, environmental, financial, structured, transportation, and transmission deals after execution, and reporting creation data to swap data repositories where an applicable regime requires it. Trading strategies and approved asset-optimization opportunities inform prospective transactions; the authorized trader or delegated execution role executes a transaction only after required pre-trade controls and approvals have been satisfied — capture is the controlled record-creation activity, not the act of purchasing or selling. Excludes trade confirmation and matching with counterparties, owned by Confirmations Management (CM-1-2-2-2); excludes risk measurement and limits (Market Risk Management, CM-1-2-2-3); excludes actualization (CM-1-2-3-1) and settlement (CM-1-2-4-1); excludes counterparty and contract lifecycle administration (Contract Management, CM-1-2-1-2). In scope: Analyze prospective deals before execution | obtain trade approval within the delegation of authority | capture executed deals by type with full commercial, operational, and regulatory terms | report creation data where an applicable regime requires it Out of scope: Trade execution as an act of purchasing or selling (authorized trader or delegated execution role) | strategy definition (CM-1-2-1-4, CM-1-2-1-1-4) | confirmation and matching (CM-1-2-2-2) | risk measurement and limits (CM-1-2-2-3) | actualization and settlement (CM-1-2-3-1, CM-1-2-4-1) | counterparty and contract administration (CM-1-2-1-2)
target_definition: Covers the independent market-risk control over the trading book: control-framework structures (risk-book structure, delegation of authority, risk limits), market-data and valuation ownership (curves, volatilities and correlations, commodity valuations), the daily and monthly control cycles, risk measurement and monitoring, position and P&L control, risk-policy compliance monitoring, scenarios, advanced analytics, and reporting. An independent control function per the approved L3 definition; the delivery model is not prescribed. Excludes enterprise-wide strategic commodity-price risk, corporate hedging policy, capital allocation, and non-trading operating exposure unless those exposures are expressly booked into the governed trading portfolio. Excludes trading decisions and strategy stewardship, which are governed by these controls (CM-1-2-1-4); excludes credit risk (CM-1-2-2-1); excludes regulatory trading compliance (CM-1-2-4-3); excludes accounting P&L and its reconciliation ownership (Accounting, CM-1-2-4-2, with the economic-to-accounting reconciliation at CM-1-2-4-2-6); excludes independent model validation (designated validation function). In scope: Maintain risk-book structure, delegation of authority, and risk limits | own curves, volatilities, and valuations | run daily and monthly control cycles | measure, monitor, and analyze market risk, positions, and P&L | report the risk picture Out of scope: Enterprise-wide commodity-price risk, corporate hedging policy, and non-trading exposure not booked into the trading portfolio | trading decisions and strategy stewardship (CM-1-2-1-4) | credit risk (CM-1-2-2-1) | regulatory trading compliance (CM-1-2-4-3) | accounting P&L (CM-1-2-4-2) | independent model validation (designated validation function)

Hamid_rationale: Trade Capture creates the controlled deal record Market Risk needs to measure positions, P&L, valuations, exposure, limits, risk compliance. Explicit reference + directionally sensible. Hamid 2026-09-24.

statement: Perform AR Reconciliation and Compliance enables Perform Period-End Processing
source_definition: Compliance in this process denotes evidence that prescribed O2C accounting controls operated as designed. It does not own enterprise regulatory compliance, Tax compliance, SOX design, Internal Audit assurance, or control-framework policy. Period reconciliation on daily foundations: the daily reconciled positions (b37) roll into period AR-to-GL reconciliation here; reconciling items are exception items with owners and aging (the standing discipline), resolved through their owning processes — never by plug or unexplained adjustment. Control design and the control framework are Finance's; independent assurance is Internal Audit's (the batch 30 distinction). Audit support supplies governed records and evidence; it makes no representations beyond them. In scope: Period AR subledger-to-GL reconciliation | reconciling-item ownership, aging, and resolution routing | O2C financial-control operation evidence assembly | internal/external audit support with governed records Out of scope: Enterprise regulatory compliance, Tax compliance, SOX design, and control-framework policy (Finance; Accountable compliance functions) | independent assurance (Internal Audit) | GL ownership (Finance) | reconciling-item fixes in owning processes (Their controls) | unexplained adjustments
target_definition: Close on evidence: the close verifies each feed — billing runs complete, applications and reconciliations current, allowances and write-offs recorded, accruals calculated, tax reconciled, intercompany issued. No period closes over a missing, unresolved, or unreconciled material feed without a documented Finance-approved exception, compensating control, owner, resolution plan, and aging/true-up requirement. Close-control artifacts include the close checklist, feed certifications, reconciliation status, the exception log, adjustment journal support, materiality assessment, owner sign-offs, true-up plans, and post-close review. Adjustments are controlled events under the delegations; cutoff enforcement follows the accounting-period controls. The Finance close calendar, formal sign-off, consolidation, and statement production are Finance's; this process delivers O2C's closed, evidenced position into them. In scope: Close-calendar execution for O2C | feed completeness and reconciliation verification with certifications | period-end adjustments under approved authority with journal support | cutoff enforcement | documented Finance-approved exceptions with compensating controls, owners, resolution plans, and aging/true-up requirements | delivery of the closed position with evidence into consolidation | post-close review Out of scope: Close calendar, policy, and formal sign-off ownership (Finance) | consolidation and statements (Finance) | the feeding processes' own work (Their owners) | undocumented closes over material gaps
promoting_evidence: ResolvedToConcept via stable ID (slug-carried, unique slug match)

Hamid_rationale: Period-End Processing cannot close O2C over an unresolved/unreconciled material feed without a Finance-approved exception; AR reconciliation provides the reconciled positions, status, exception ownership/aging, and controlled O2C evidence the close verifies. Hamid 2026-09-24.
